display.purpose: Story heading; responsive explicit sizes override its clamp.

body.purpose: Editor text; preview line height is 1.9.

shadows.name: field-focus
shadows.purpose: Auth input focus, with orange border.

motion.name: opening
motion.purpose: Auth form / story opening, translateY 12px to 0; delays 140ms / 80ms for supporting copy.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Global reduced-motion preference. Three.js keeps a static frame.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ink action with orange fine-pointer hover and a small press response.
components.css: .ds-button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:47px;padding:0 22px;border:1px solid var(--ink);border-radius:7px;background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper);font:500 14px var(--sans);cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 150ms ease,transform 150ms var(--ease-out),border-color 150ms ease}.ds-button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--orange);outline-offset:4px}.ds-button:active{transform:scale(.97)}.ds-button:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed}@media(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.ds-button:not(:disabled):hover{transform:translateY(-1px);background:var(--orange);border-color:var(--orange);color:var(--paper)}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button{transition-duration:.01ms}}

components.name: Auth Field
components.description: Transparent field with an orange focus border and halo.

components.name: Note Card
components.description: Paper note preview; selected state uses orange-light.
components.css: .ds-note{display:flex;flex-direction:column;text-align:left;min-width:0;min-height:218px;padding:21px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer;transition:transform 180ms var(--ease-out),border-color 150ms ease,box-shadow 180ms ease}.ds-note h3{margin:0 0 12px;font:400 23px/1.2 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.3px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-note p{margin:0;font:13px/1.8 var(--sans);color:var(--muted)}.ds-note:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--orange);outline-offset:4px}.ds-note[aria-pressed=true]{border-color:var(--orange);background:var(--orange-light)}@media(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.ds-note:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);border-color:var(--muted);box-shadow:0 8px 22px #29261509}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-note{transition-duration:.01ms}}

narrative.overview: NotesNexa pairs a warm editorial opening with the density of a working notes app. Cream and paper surfaces, dark ink, burnt orange accents and expressive serif titles make personal work feel approachable. Controls stay familiar and the writing surface stays still.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper surfaces with restrained orange emphasis.
Serif headings and sans-serif working controls.
One dimensional opening sculpture; short responses during work.
Responsive navigation, editable titles and readable Markdown.
dos: Do reuse CSS custom properties so light/dark themes remain coherent.
Do reserve serif type for expressive hierarchy and keep working controls in DM Sans.
Do preserve wrapped, autosized titles, visible focus and responsive drawer behavior.
Do keep decoration independent of authentication and respect pause/reduced-motion states.
donts: Don't add continuous motion to writing or task surfaces.
Don't replace the warm palette with unrelated accent families.
Don't introduce invented reviews, figures or ranking claims.
Don't document or expose private login credentials as interface or design content.
